_provenance: Real capture: POST https://p0stman.com/api/agent against a live production agent ('Zee', found via a2aregistry.org, agent card served at the legacy /.well-known/agent.json path), 2026-07-07. The Task object has no 'kind' discriminator at all -- just id/contextId/status/artifacts. Also uses {'type':'text',...} parts instead of {'kind':'text',...} (handled fine already since _extract_texts only checks for a 'text' key, agnostic to any discriminator field name or its value). Motivated _task_from_result() treating 'status' present + no 'kind' as sufficient evidence of a Task.
